description.text: The first enhanced expansion pack of the ADV series, numbered ex1, released on 24 October 2003. It was made to power up the Team Magma and Team Aqua Half Deck W sets released with it, along with decks built from the first three ADV packs. Its packs hold ten cards, two of them holo: one Pokémon and one Energy. The cards are numbered to 80. In English it became EX Team Magma vs Team Aqua in March 2004.
